name: One Metal, Many Mods
description: Several mods add the same metal.

pages.title: One Metal, Many Mods
pages.text:
Several mods add the same metal. In this pack one version of each is **canonical**: other mods' recipes now make and use that item, so they stack and match. Leftover items convert 1:1 in a crafting grid.\
\
Full list: [#](2E5AAC)[Shared Metals](entry://materials/shared_metals)[#]().

- **Steel**: [#](2E5AAC)[TFMG](entry://industry/tfmg_steel)[#]()'s. Alloyed, Create Big Cannons and Create Nuclear steel convert to it
- **Bronze**: [#](2E5AAC)[Alloyed](entry://industry/alloyed)[#]()'s
- **Lead**: Create Nuclear's, the only lead ore. TFMG lead converts to it

- **Copper wire**: Crafts & Additions'
- **Sulfur dust**: TFMG's
- **Salt, cocoa butter, cocoa powder**: Create Ratatouille's

Conversion is one for one with no gain, so loops can't be farmed. Check [#](2E5AAC)[JEI](entry://start_here/tools)[#]() (R, U) for the recipes.

- **Titanium**: ore only on Northstar's planets, but you can make it on Earth by crushing limestone or sand into Rutile and running an [#](2E5AAC)[assembly line](entry://create_basics/brass_and_assembly)[#]()
- **Platinum**: a Create Propulsion ore, needed for vector thrusters

- **Zinc**: Create's metal, needed for brass. Productive Bees can make zinc and lead bees too.

Crushing ores with Create gives more metal per block. See [#](2E5AAC)[Ore Doubling](entry://materials/ore_doubling)[#]().
